summary.text: Brian Thompson is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 20 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brian Thompson's career experience includes working as a general foreman for a sheet metal contractor.
He previously served on the Woonsocket City Council.
Thompson took office in the State Senate on January 7, 2025, succeeding Roger Picard, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
